title: Make PostgreSQL connection configurable (host, port, db name, user)
description: A native Postgres (Postgres.app) on 127.0.0.1:5432 shadows the Docker dev DB, so the app can't reach it. User decision (2026-10-21): configure the whole Postgres connection via env vars instead of hardcoding it. application.yml: spring.datasource.url jdbc:postgresql://${DB_HOST:localhost}:${DB_PORT:5432}/${DB_NAME:shipir}, username ${DB_USER:shipir}, password ${DB_PASSWORD} (no default). docker-compose.dev.yml: POSTGRES_DB ${DB_NAME:-shipir}, POSTGRES_USER ${DB_USER:-shipir}, published port ${DB_PORT:-5432}:5432, healthcheck uses the container's own env ($${POSTGRES_USER}/$${POSTGRES_DB}), not hardcoded names. .env.example lists all five vars with defaults and a comment that DB_PORT=5433 avoids a clash with a native Postgres. The Spring app does not read .env itself; README explains exporting the vars (e.g. set -a; source .env; set +a) before spring-boot:run.
acceptance_criteria:
- application.yml uses DB_HOST/DB_PORT/DB_NAME/DB_USER with defaults localhost/5432/shipir/shipir and DB_PASSWORD without default; no secrets committed
- A test verifies the resolved spring.datasource.url/username for defaults and for overridden values (no real DB needed beyond the Testcontainers baseline)
- docker-compose.dev.yml takes DB_NAME/DB_USER/DB_PORT from .env with the same defaults; healthcheck has no hardcoded names; docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml config validates with only DB_PASSWORD set and with DB_PORT=5433
- .env.example documents all five vars; README local-DB and backend sections explain them and how to run the app with them; CLAUDE.md Code Map/Build & Test updated
- ./backend/mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify passes
close_reason: DB_HOST/PORT/NAME/USER configurable in app and compose, DatasourcePropertiesTest (ab6f8ee)

title: Add Flyway migrations V1-V4 (users, docker_hosts, stacks, stack_versions)
description: backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_users.sql .. V4__create_stack_versions.sql based on the HANDOFF.md drafts, with these decided changes: every TIMESTAMP column becomes TIMESTAMPTZ; FKs to users keep no ON DELETE (RESTRICT); stacks.host_id and stack_versions.stack_id keep ON DELETE CASCADE. gen_random_uuid() without pgcrypto. Follow CLAUDE.md Flyway rules (one migration per table, never edit applied ones).
acceptance_criteria:
- V1-V4 apply cleanly in the Testcontainers baseline; flyway_schema_history shows 4 successful versions
- Integration test (JdbcTemplate against the Testcontainers DB) verifies: timestamp columns are timestamptz; users.username unique; stacks (host_id, name) unique; deleting a docker_host cascades to its stacks and their stack_versions; deleting a user referenced by a host/stack/version fails
- ./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify passes
- HANDOFF.md review notes on TIMESTAMP and ON DELETE marked as decided; Code Map updated
close_reason: V1-V4 migrations with TIMESTAMPTZ/RESTRICT/CASCADE and SchemaMigrationTest (514edc1)

title: Add Flyway, PostgreSQL datasource and Testcontainers test baseline
description:
In backend/pom.xml add spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, flyway-core, flyway-database-postgresql (separate artifact since Flyway 10), postgresql (runtime), and Testcontainers (postgresql + junit-jupiter, via Spring Boot's testcontainers support). Configure application.yml exactly as the HANDOFF.md draft (ddl-auto: validate, open-in-view: false, flyway locations classpath:db/migration, baseline-on-migrate false, validate-on-migrate true) with database/user 'shipir' and password ${DB_PASSWORD}.
Create a reusable test baseline: a @TestConfiguration with a @ServiceConnection PostgreSQLContainer (postgres:16-alpine) that integration tests import, and switch the context-load test to it. No migrations yet (next task) — create backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/ with a .gitkeep if Flyway needs the directory.
acceptance_criteria:
- Context-load integration test starts against a Testcontainers Postgres 16 and passes with ./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify
- No test requires a locally running Postgres or DB_PASSWORD
- application.yml matches the HANDOFF.md draft (names adjusted to shipir); no secrets committed
- Running the app with the dev compose DB up and DB_PASSWORD set starts cleanly (./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml spring-boot:run)
- README/CLAUDE.md note that Docker must be running for tests; Code Map updated
notes: Database Access rule: running the app against the dev DB (spring-boot:run applies Flyway) is a DB write. The sub-agent must not do it; the orchestrator asks the user for consent before verifying that acceptance criterion.
close_reason: JPA/Flyway/Postgres deps, application.yml, Testcontainers baseline; app start verified against dev DB (0dc79a7)

Add backend/src/main/resources/application.yml with spring.application.name=shipir and spring.jpa.open-in-view=false placeholder only where it does not require JPA (otherwise leave JPA keys for the DB task).

- HANDOFF.md open decisions: Maven vs Gradle, Java/Spring Boot version (with exact version) and MVC vs WebFlux marked decided

title: Project skeleton: Spring Boot backend that builds and runs its tests
description:
Build-order step 1 (HANDOFF.md). Turn backend/ into a Spring Boot app with the package structure from CLAUDE.md, a local Postgres via docker-compose.dev.yml, Flyway migrations V1-V4 and a Testcontainers test baseline, so every later feature starts from a green build.

Decisions (2026-10-21): Maven with wrapper (mvnw); Java 25 (current LTS) with the latest stable Spring Boot GA; classic Spring MVC + WebSocket/STOMP (no WebFlux); all timestamp columns TIMESTAMPTZ; FKs to users stay RESTRICT (no ON DELETE), users are deactivated rather than deleted later.
Assumption: database and user are named 'shipir' (the handoff's 'dockerpanel' was the old working title).

In scope: build tooling, Spring Boot app class, package skeleton, base application.yml, dev compose file, Flyway + V1-V4, Testcontainers baseline, docs/Code Map updates.
Out of scope: Spring Security/auth, JPA entities and repositories (they come with each feature), docker-java, frontend changes, CI pipeline.
acceptance_criteria:
- ./mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify passes on a fresh clone with only JDK 25 and Docker installed
- docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up starts Postgres 16 and the app starts against it with Flyway applying V1-V4
- README setup section and CLAUDE.md Build & Test / Code Map describe the real commands
- HANDOFF.md records the decisions above
close_reason: Spring Boot backend skeleton builds green, dev Postgres via compose, Flyway V1-V4 applied

title: Set up Playwright with API-mock fixture and smoke spec
description:
In frontend/: add @playwright/test (pnpm), playwright.config.ts (testDir e2e, Chromium project only, webServer starting the Vite app with reuseExistingServer for local runs, baseURL from the webServer port, retries 0 locally), scripts e2e (playwright test) and e2e:ui (playwright test --ui).
frontend/e2e/fixtures/api.ts: a Playwright test fixture that intercepts **/api/** for every test, lets specs register typed mock responses (status + JSON body) per method and path, and fails the test when the app calls an /api route that has no mock.
frontend/e2e/app.spec.ts: smoke spec, opens / and asserts the Shipir heading via getByRole.
Exclude e2e/ from Vitest (vite.config.ts test.exclude) so pnpm test does not pick up *.spec.ts. Make sure e2e/ is type-checked (tsc -b, e.g. a tsconfig.e2e.json referenced from tsconfig.json) and linted by oxlint. Add test-results/, playwright-report/ and blob-report/ to frontend/.gitignore.
acceptance_criteria:
- pnpm exec playwright install chromium followed by pnpm e2e passes (smoke spec green)
- The fixture has its own spec proving: a registered mock is served to the page, and an unmocked /api call fails the test (use test.fail or an expected-failure assertion)
- pnpm test runs only Vitest unit tests (e2e specs excluded) and still passes
- pnpm lint and pnpm build (tsc -b) pass and cover e2e/
- Playwright output dirs are gitignored
- Code Map in CLAUDE.md lists playwright.config.ts, e2e/fixtures/api.ts and e2e/app.spec.ts
close_reason: Playwright (Chromium) with auto api-mock fixture, fixture spec and smoke spec; e2e excluded from Vitest, type-checked and linted (563a56e)
